name: Li Wei
bio:
Li Wei's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for fluid dynamics, leading him to pursue a doctorate in computational engineering. While consulting for an aerospace firm, he developed algorithms that caught the attention of a Formula 1 team, and he was recruited to optimize aerodynamic performance. After several years in F1, Li transitioned to a leading role in data analytics, where he developed predictive models that gave his teams a competitive edge.

Li's approach is deeply rooted in scientific rigor, but he also recognizes the importance of intuition and experience. He believes that the best insights come from combining quantitative analysis with qualitative observation. Li's distinctive ability to translate complex data into actionable strategies has made him a sought-after consultant in the world of motorsports. He now seeks to take his expertise to a new team, ready to apply his well-honed skills to new challenges.

Li's key strength lies in his ability to foresee trends and opportunities before they become apparent to others. He is passionate about developing innovative solutions that can provide a significant advantage on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with slight receding hairline
physical.description: Li has a focused expression and a wiry build, reflecting his intense dedication to his work.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of a textbook on computational fluid dynamics.
Has a habit of sketching complex formulas on napkins during meetings.
Insists on using a traditional abacus alongside his computer for certain calculations.
